description: A developer-first Flutter list, built lazily like ListView.builder, with async pagination, pull-to-refresh, and sync-or-async search.
rules: list_smith is a lazily built list, like ListView.builder, with async pagination, pull-to-refresh, and sync-or-async search. Concrete usage rules (the widget API, the data-source and search/cache policy) will be added here once the public API is finalised.
